# Polygon network

A blockchain platform that provides a scalable, Ethereum-compatible environment for smart contracts and decentralized applications. [[Álvaro Jiménez Martínez]] used Polygon as the underlying blockchain for the real estate tokenization platform at [[UnknownGravity]]. The platform, a marketplace for tokenized real estate assets, listed over €2.2 million in property assets.

## Key Features

- Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) compatibility
- Low transaction fees (gas)
- Fast block times
- Proof-of-Stake (PoS) consensus
